78873-clendenen-s-detective-manual.title: Clendenen S Detective Manual
78873-clendenen-s-detective-manual.creator: Unknown
78873-clendenen-s-detective-manual.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. He must have stability of moral character which will withstand the severest tests. He must be not only “as honest as the day is long” but also as honest as the night is longer. His word must be as good as his bond. A reputation for absolute honesty is acquired only by the sternest adherence to the principles of a square deal.

arxiv-2106-06026.title: Hardness of Approximate Diameter: Now for Undirected Graphs
arxiv-2106-06026.creator: Mina Dalirrooyfard, Ray Li, Virginia Vassilevska Williams
arxiv-2106-06026.description: Abstract Approximating the graph diameter is a basic task of both theoretical and practical interest. A simple folklore algorithm can output a 2-approximation to the diameter in linear time by running BFS from an arbitrary vertex. It has been open whether a better approximation is possible in near-linear time.

arxiv-2203-00404.title: The influence of the couplings on the Z-production at ILC in the Randall - Sundrum model
arxiv-2203-00404.description: Abstract An attempt is made to present the influence of the couplings on e − ​ e + e^{-}e^{+} scattering process with polarized initial beams in the Randall-Sundrum (RS) model. We have studied the contribution of radion, Higgs and gauge bosons on the Z-production cross-section at International Linear Colliders (ILC).

arxiv-2211-04298.title: Current and diffusion of Overdamped Active Brownian Particles in a Ratchet Potential
arxiv-2211-04298.creator: Arjun S R
arxiv-2211-04298.description: Abstract (Statistical Mechanics of Soft Condensed Matter Physics) Abstract The transport properties of a spherical active brownian particle in a periodic potential under heavy damping is considerd. The self propelled particle is subjected to the asymmetric potential, detailed balance is lost and the particles generate a non zero drift speed.

arxiv-2409-14719.title: DiSPo: Diffusion-SSM based Policy Learning for Coarse-to-Fine Action Discretization
arxiv-2409-14719.creator: Nayoung Oh, Jaehyeong Jang, Moonkyeong Jung, Daehyung Park
arxiv-2409-14719.description: Abstract We aim to solve the problem of learning user-intended granular skills from multi-granularity demonstrations. Traditional learning-from-demonstration methods typically rely on extensive fine-grained data, interpolation techniques, or dynamics models, which are ineffective at encoding or decoding the diverse granularities inherent in skills.

arxiv-2503-08241.title: HASARD: A Benchmark for Vision-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning in Embodied Agents
arxiv-2503-08241.creator: Tristan Tomilin Meng Fang Mykola Pechenizkiy
arxiv-2503-08241.description: Abstract Advancing safe autonomous systems through reinforcement learning (RL) requires robust benchmarks to evaluate performance, analyze methods, and assess agent competencies. Humans primarily rely on embodied visual perception to safely navigate and interact with their surroundings, making it a valuable capability for RL agents. However, existing vision-based 3D benchmarks only consider simple navigation tasks.

arxiv-2505-19292.title: A likelihood-based Bayesian inference framework for the calibration of and selection between stochastic velocity-jump models
arxiv-2505-19292.creator: Arianna Ceccarelli, Alexander P. Browning, TaiChaiamarit, IlanDavis, Ruth E. Baker
arxiv-2505-19292.description: Abstract Advances in experimental techniques allow the collection of high-resolution spatio-temporal data that track individual motile entities. These tracking data can be used to calibrate mathematical models describing the motility of individual entities. The challenges in calibrating models for single-agent motion derive from the intrinsic characteristics of experimental data, collected at discrete time steps and with measurement noise.

arxiv-2508-17453.title: Entropy-Based Analysis of Urban Pollutant-Weather Correlations
arxiv-2508-17453.creator: Suchismita Banerjee, Koyena Ghosh, Moumita De, Urna Basu, Banasri Basu
arxiv-2508-17453.description: Abstract We employ statistical physics and information-theoretic methods to quantify the dependencies between key atmospheric pollutants and meteorological variables across multiple Indian cities. To capture both linear and nonlinear relationships, we introduce a Composite Correlation Index (CCI) that combines the Pearson correlation coefficient with entropy-based measures, including mutual information and conditional entropy.

arxiv-2602-08351.title: The Chicken and Egg Dilemma: Co-optimizing Data and Model Configurations for LLMs
arxiv-2602-08351.creator: Zhiliang Chen, Alfred Wei Lun Leong, Shao Yong Ong, Apivich Hemachandra, Gregory Kang Ruey Lau, Chuan-Sheng Foo, Zhengyuan Liu, Nancy F. Chen, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low
arxiv-2602-08351.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zhiliang Chen, Alfred Wei Lun Leong, Shao Yong Ong, Apivich Hemachandra, Gregory Kang Ruey Lau, Chuan-Sheng Foo, Zhengyuan Liu, Nancy F. Chen, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low. Co-optimizing data and model configurations for training LLMs presents a classic chicken-and-egg dilemma: The best training data configuration (e.g., data mixture) for a downstream task depends on the chosen model configuration (e.g., model architecture), and vice versa.

In 2018, the Advanced Research Project Agency – Energy (ARPA-E) launched the Grid Optimization Competition (GOC) [1], a series of competitive challenges intended to accelerate innovation in decision support software used to schedule power grid operations, making them as efficient

pmc-10490949.title: Tight bounds for the median of a gamma distribution
pmc-10490949.creator: Richard F. Lyon, Pablo Martin Rodriguez, Pablo Martin Rodriguez, Pablo Martin Rodriguez
pmc-10490949.description: The median of a standard gamma distribution, as a function of its shape parameter k, has no known representation in terms of elementary functions. In this work we prove the tightest upper and lower bounds of the form 2−1/k(A + k): an upper bound with A = e−γ (with γ being the Euler–Mascheroni constant) and a lower bound with A=log(2)-13.

pmc-10636451.title: Comparison of percutaneous coronary intervention of native coronary artery versus bypass graft in patients with prior coronary artery bypass grafting
pmc-10636451.creator: Zhiqiang Yang, Qiaoyu Shao, Qiuxuan Li, Yufei Wang, Zaiqiang Liu, Shutong Dong, Xiaolong Ma, Lin Liang, Jing Liang, Fei Gao, Lixia Yang, Xiaoli Liu, Yueping Li, Yujie Zhou, Xiaoteng Ma, Dongmei Shi, Zhijian Wang
pmc-10636451.description: BackgroundLarge number of patients with prior coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) need repeat revascularization yearly, and percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is the optimal treatment strategy for such patients. However, it is still controversial whether PCI of native coronary artery or bypass graft is more beneficial.

pmc-10709731.title: Trends in medical care utilization in patients with cancer: An analysis of real‐world data in a tertiary hospital in Korea, 2014–2019
pmc-10709731.creator: Jung‐Hyun Won, Tae Kyu Chung, Joochul Lee, Sangwon Yoon, Yoomin Jeon, Howard Lee
pmc-10709731.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundRising costs of cancer treatments challenge even areas with universal health coverage. There's a need to assess current medical care utilization trends among patients with cancer to guide public health policy, resource allocation, and set informed healthcare goals.MethodsWe analyzed the latest trends in medical care utilization by cancer patients in four areas—drugs, radiation therapy (RT), surgery, and diagnostic procedures—using clinical databases extracted from electronic medical records of a tertiary hospital in Korea between 2014 and 2019.

pmc-11429203.title: Developing New Peptides and Peptide–Drug Conjugates for Targeting the FGFR2 Receptor-Expressing Tumor Cells and 3D Spheroids
pmc-11429203.creator: Mary A Biggs, Amrita Das, Beatriz G Goncalves, Molly E Murray, Sophia A Frantzeskos, Hannah L Hunt, Chau Ahn N Phan, Ipsita A Banerjee, Hermann Ehrlich
pmc-11429203.description: In this work, we utilized a biomimetic approach for targeting KATO (III) tumor cells and 3D tumoroids. Specifically, the binding interactions of the bioactive short peptide sequences ACSAG (A-pep) and LPHVLTPEAGAT (L-pep) with the fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR2) kinase domain was investigated for the first time. Both peptides have been shown to be derived from natural resources previously.

pmc-11712419.title: Detection of presymptomatic cerebral amyloid angiopathy, CAA, using diffusion MRI analysis of cortical grey matter in hereditary mutation carriers
pmc-11712419.creator: Steven A Chance, Ian Hardingham, Michele Valotti, Sanneke van Rooden, Jeroen van der Grond
pmc-11712419.description: BackgroundHCHWA‐D mutation carriers experience highly heritable early onset of cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA). Diffusion MRI appears to be sensitive to CAA and detects punctate cortical lesions in CAA cases post‐mortem. DTI of white matter tracts was found to be sensitive to alterations in symptomatic HCHWA‐D carriers but did not show alterations in presymptomatic carriers (Schouten et al. https://doi.org/10.1161/JAHA.118.011288.).

pmc-12398234.title: Association between the dietary index for gut microbiota and osteoporosis among middle-aged and older adults in the United States
pmc-12398234.creator: Yiming Zhan, Yuhang Liu, Jialing Tang, Siyao Gao
pmc-12398234.description: Objective: Osteoporosis is an age-related disease, and the gut microbiota plays a crucial role in regulating bone mineral density (BMD) through modulating nutrient absorption, immunity, and bone metabolism. This research examines the association between the dietary index for gut microbiota (DI-GM) and osteoporosis prevalence among US middle-aged and older adults.

pmc-12469680.title: The Allosteric Communication Network in the Activation of Antithrombin by Heparin
pmc-12469680.creator: Gonzalo Izaguirre, Dominique Belin
pmc-12469680.description: The allosteric activation of antithrombin (AT) involves a conformational shift from a native, repressed (R) to a heparin-bound, activated (AH) state. Using computational structural analysis, we identified an evolutionarily conserved allosteric communication network (ACN) comprising the residues H120, Y131, and Y166, which undergo key structural displacements during this transition.

pmc-12578883.title: A sterna migration algorithm-based efficient bionic engineering optimization algorithm
pmc-12578883.creator: Hongwei Bai, Weiyan Tong, Baowu Wei, Chongxi Duan, Qiang Liu
pmc-12578883.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study proposes the Sterna Migration Algorithm (StMA), a novel metaheuristic optimization method that integrates multi-cluster sectoral diffusion, leader–follower dynamics, adaptive perturbation regulation, and a multi-phase termination mechanism to achieve a dynamic balance between global exploration and local exploitation. StMA was systematically evaluated on the CEC2023 benchmark functions and the CEC2014 constrained engineering design problems, with comparisons against several mainstream population-based algorithms through 30 independent runs per problem.

pmc-12627943.title: Genetic heterogeneity and homogeneity among orofacial cleft subtypes: genome-wide association studies in the cleft collective
pmc-12627943.creator: Kyle Dack, Kerstin U Ludwig, Evie Stergiakouli, Jonathan Sandy, Sethlina Aryee, George Davey Smith, Amy Davies, Yvonne Wren, Gemma C Sharp, Kerry Humphries, Elisabeth Mangold, Lucy Goudswaard, Karen Ho, Tom Dudding, Sarah J Lewis
pmc-12627943.description: Several genome wide association studies (GWASs) of orofacial cleft have been conducted. However only a few such studies to date have combined all cleft cases, focused on subtypes other than non-syndromic cleft lip with/without cleft palate, or investigated subtype heterogeneity.

pmc-12658732.title: High levels of EPHB2 expression predict a poor prognosis and promote tumor progression in endometrial cancer
pmc-12658732.creator: Yanlai Xiao, Jian Wang, Xiangzhai Zhao, Jie Xu, Huan Zhao, Zhaojun Guo, Jun Zhao, Yajing Zhang, Ruoxi Wang, Yiwei Zhang
pmc-12658732.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Endometrial cancer (EC) exhibits increasing incidence and mortality, necessitating novel prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. This study systematically investigates EPHB2 as a potential biomarker through comprehensive bioinformatics (TIMER 2.0, Human Protein Atlas, Xanadu Academic Online, Sento Academic Online, TCGA, GeneMANIA, GSEA, BEST database, and SCAR database) and experimental analyses (si-EPHB2 and OE-EPHB2 RL95-2 cell models with RT-qPCR, western blot, CCK-8, wound healing, Transwell, and TUNEL assays).

pmc-13582656.title: The relation between school nurses’ professional role, jurisdictions and health promotion in Finnish compulsory schools: a qualitative study
pmc-13582656.creator: Frida Gädda, Christel Sundqvist, Anna K Forsman
pmc-13582656.description: Background:School nurses are a vital part of school healthcare; however, research on the experiences of the profession in relation to health promotion is limited. A deeper understanding of school nurses’ professional remits could uncover new approaches to school-based health promotion – with implications for student healthcare services.
